content.text:
key = (peer_id, req["call_id"], req["cseq"], req["method"])
            commit = (acc, selected, tuple(asserted), from_canon, req["tag"],
                      req["target"], privacy, egress, req["body"])
            ent = ledger.get(key)
            if ent is not None:
                if ent[0] == commit:
                    replayed += 1
                    first = ent[1]
                    decision = "replay"
                else:
                    rejected += 1
                    results.append({"index": idx, "decision": "reject",
                                    "reason": "conflict"})
                    continue
            else:
                if len(ledger) >= capacity:
                    old = order.pop(0)[1]
                    ledger.pop(old, None)
                ledger[key] = (commit, idx, t)
                order.append((t, key))
                accepted += 1
                first = idx
                decision = "accept"

            results.append({
                "index": idx,
                "decision": decision,
                "first": first,
                "account": acc,
                "identity": selected,
                "from": from_out,
                "pai": list(pai_out),
                "method": req["method"],
                "target": req["target"],
                "call_id": req["call_id"],
                "cseq": req["cseq"],
                "tag": req["tag"],
                "privacy": privacy,
                "body_sha256": hashlib.sha256(req["body"]).hexdigest(),
            })
        except Exception:
            rejected += 1
            results.append({"index": idx, "decision": "reject",
                            "reason": "syntax"})
            continue
        except Exception:
            rejected += 1
            results.append({"index": idx, "decision": "reject",
                            "reason": "syntax"})
            continue

    return {
        "results": results,
        "accepted": accepted,
        "replayed": replayed,
        "rejected": rejected,
        "live": len(ledger),
    }


def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    try:
        cfg = parse_envelope(raw)
    except EnvError as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("invalid envelope: %s\n" % exc)
        return 2
    out = run(cfg)
    sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out, separators=(",", ":")))
    sys.stdout.write("\n")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
